sections.A: ACL reconstruction mein phata ligament graft se badla jata hai (aksar hamstring ya patellar tendon). Graft ko mazboot hone mein mahine lagte hain.
sections.B: Surgery se pehle ke goals: sujan na ho, poori extension, achha quadriceps aur normal chaal. Is se nateeja behtar hota hai.
sections.C: Graft ki qism, saath mein meniscus repair (wazan aur flexion ki pabandi badalti hai) aur surgeon ka protocol.
sections.D: Effusion (stroke test), extension aur flexion, quadriceps ki taaqat aur baad mein hop tests.
sections.G: Pindli mein dard aur sujan (DVT), bukhar aur laal garam zakhm (infection), ya extension ka nuqsan: refer.
sections.H: Hafton ke bajaye criteria par aage barhein: pehle sujan aur extension, phir taaqat, phir daurna, phir khel. Hamesha surgeon ki hidayat ke saath.
sections.J: Quadriceps sets, SLR aur heel prop, phir leg press, squats aur step-ups, phir hop aur khel ki training.
sections.K: Shuru mein quadriceps ke liye NMES, aur thand aur compression.
sections.M: Effusion, range, quadriceps LSI, hop LSI, IKDC aur ACL-RSI (hosla) dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Pehle hafte poori extension sab se ahem hai, warna chaal aur ghutna kharab ho sakte hain.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
